text: Web OverviewPage test flakes under load: join failure re-reads the inbox

Reading the test: it re-mocks getPendingInvites to [Chores] right after the Invitations heading appears, BEFORE clicking Join on Camping. The overview re-reads the inbox on every lastSyncAt change (useEffect [loadInvites, lastSyncAt]), and the provider's mount sync sets lastSyncAt when its mocked api.sync resolves. If that re-read calls the mock after the re-mock — the mount sync resolving late, or the passive-effect flush landing inside userEvent.click's own macrotask delays — Camping leaves the DOM before or during the click, the join never starts, and findByRole('alert') times out: an ordering race the load only widens, not a short timeout. Candidate fix: move the inbox re-mock into redeemInvite's rejection, so the inbox changes exactly when the join fails and no earlier re-read can see it. Reproduction loop (30 runs under load) in progress.

Reproduced: 5 of 30 runs of the single test under parallel load (pytest -n 6 + vitest + Gradle) failed, every one with 'Unable to find role="alert"' after the click, and the DOM dump at that moment holds Chores and no Camping card: the mount sync's inbox re-read had already taken the re-mocked [Chores], so the click found no join to start. Confirms the ordering race; not a timeout. Fix: redeemInvite's rejection installs the [Chores] inbox itself, so no earlier re-read can see it. Verification loop of the fixed test (30 runs, same load) in progress.
